fusions.name: Reeking Warning
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of musk that deals 10 damage to everything caught in it, knocks each back 3 tiles and has a 50% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Musked Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a tine tipped with musk that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunter's Regret
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Marked and Avoided
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10% against enemies carrying your afflictions.
